positive.prompt: Analyze this compiled ELF binary and check its security mitigations, architecture, and entropy
Disassemble this function and interpret the x86_64 assembly logic and calling conventions
Reverse engineer this proprietary network protocol payload and unpack its binary framing
Inspect this Ghidra decompilation and locate cryptographic constant signatures and string references

negative.prompt: Audit this web form for cross-site scripting vulnerabilities
Debug why this unit test failed after refactoring

evals.prompt: Perform static triage on a stripped 64-bit ELF executable, identify its architecture, check NX and ASLR mitigations, and detect potential packing.
evals.expected_output: Structured binary triage report separating observed metadata, disassembled features, and unverified hypotheses.
expectations: Binary architecture, bitness, endianness, and security mitigations are clearly identified.
Packing and entropy analysis is clearly separated from confirmed code logic.
